title: The Feast of Unleavened Bread and the Redemption of the Firstborn
description: The Lord commands Moses to consecrate all the firstborn among the Israelites. Moses instructs the people to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days in the month of Abib, as a reminder of their departure from Egypt. When Israel enters the land, every firstborn animal shall be offered to the Lord, while firstborn donkeys and sons must be redeemed. This is to serve as a sign on your hand and a mark between your eyes, and parents are to explain its meaning when their children ask.
